## File Contents Summary

**1. Hero.tsx** - Landing hero section with:
- Animated title and subtitle in Arabic

**2. Stats.tsx** - Statistics counter section featuring:
- 4 animated stat cards (500+ clients, 98% satisfaction, 1200+ projects, 5 years experience)
- useCounter hook for animated number counting
- IntersectionObserver for triggering animations on scroll

**3. Services.tsx** - 6 service cards displaying:
- Business Intelligence (BI)
- UI/UX Design
- No-Code Development
- AI Solutions
- Cloud Infrastructure
- Business Consulting
- Each with icons, descriptions, features list, and gradients

- Certification badge (ISO 9001:2015)
- 4 value propositions (accuracy, speed, security, support)
- CTA button

**5. HowItWorks.tsx** - 4-step process flow:
- Consultation & Analysis
- Planning & Design
- Development & Building
- Launch & Support
- Connected by decorative line

**6. Pricing.tsx** - 3 pricing tiers:
- Starter (1,499 SR/month)
- Professional (3,999 SR/month) - marked as most popular
- Enterprise (custom pricing)
- Monthly/yearly toggle with 30% discount
- Feature comparison lists

**7. CTA.tsx** - Call-to-action section with:
- Email and phone contact options
- Free consultation pitch
- Trust badges (no contracts, free consultation, 1-hour response)

**8. Navbar.tsx** - Fixed navigation bar with:
- Logo and branding
- 6 navigation links
- CTA buttons ("تواصل معنا" and "ابدأ الآن")
- Scroll-triggered styling changes
